additional_info.subject: RE: ID0377393-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / P0 170001062] IMD_C2 error CRM:01811000268
additional_info.body:
Hello Szymon,
I hope you're doing well. I wanted to inform you that we've inspected the charger.
According to the error report, the IMD wasn't receiving data through Modbus within 5 seconds, leading to a discrepancy between the relay and Modbus values. However, there are no active error flags at present, and outlet 3 is nowavailable for charging.
Kindly confirm from your end.
Thank you
Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team-
Ankita
